title: India Hypertension Control Initiative (IHCI) Standard Clinical Protocol
organization: ICMR, MoHFW, WHO Country Office for India

chunks.content: Hypertension is defined as sustained systolic blood pressure >= 140 mmHg and/or diastolic blood pressure >= 90 mmHg. Standard protocol recommends initiation with Telmisartan (40mg once daily) or Amlodipine (5mg once daily), or fixed-dose combination therapy for Stage 2 hypertension. Daily dietary sodium intake must be limited to less than 2 grams per day (equivalent to under 5 grams / 1 flat teaspoon of table salt). Patients must never abruptly discontinue antihypertensive medications to avoid rebound hypertension crises.
chunks.contraindications: ACE inhibitors / ARBs (such as Telmisartan, Ramipril) are contraindicated in pregnancy due to fetal renal toxicity. Avoid potassium supplements with ARBs without prior serum potassium monitoring.
chunks.warnings: Seek emergency medical care immediately if blood pressure exceeds 180/120 mmHg, or if high BP is accompanied by chest pain, shortness of breath, severe blinding headache, blurred vision, or speech difficulty.
chunks.home_care: Regular daily home BP monitoring recorded at the same time in seated rest; DASH dietary pattern emphasizing fresh green vegetables, pulses, and whole grains; avoid papads, pickles, and packaged salty snacks.
chunks.citation: India Hypertension Control Initiative (IHCI) Treatment Protocols, ICMR-MoHFW (2024), Protocol Card 1 & 2.
